question: Does the unchanged baseline binary keep the per-case p95 worker/direct ratio at or below 1.10 in every block on an unattended host? Steady-state boundary cost on a quiet host.
binary: probe-base only (sha256 784bbc105253ed6c5dfb2c0febef3c93675354d6d4b8bcf2000f610b08b063ed); the buffered-stdin candidate stays rejected and is not re-tested, to avoid re-running until a preferred outcome appears.

decision_rule: Report every block. State 'gate holds on an unattended host' only if all four blocks pass 1.10; otherwise report the failing blocks. Sets 1 and 2 remain unchanged.
conditions: User away; no other heavy task scheduled by this session during the set; background OS activity not instrumented.
